QuestInfo.name: Bruce's Request 2
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1012111##k has a really big request for you.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1012111##k made a huge request. He wants you to find his lost Green Mushroom Doll in the #m100040000#. But what would the #bGolems#k want with a doll?\r\n\r\n#questorder1##i4034071:# #t4034071:# #c4034071# / 1
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #t4034071# to #p1012111#. #p1012111# was quite happy and went back to his research. Glad that's over.

0.0: Can you go back to the #bGolem's Temple#k and bring the item back?\r\n#L0##bThat sounds easy. What is this item you seek?#l\n#k
0.1: It's... Well, it's a #bDejected Green Mushroom Puppet#k. It looks like a regular Green Mushroom, but it'll have a weird expression.\r\n#L0##bA puppet? A Dejected Green Mushroom Puppet?#l\n#k
0.2: It's a very important puppet. Monsters all over Victoria Island have been going nuts, and these puppets are always nearby when it happens. There HAS to be some connection!\r\n#L0##b...Perhaps the monsters are offended by the puppets?#l\n#k
0.3: Off...ended? Um, well, perhaps. Whatever the case may be, we need that puppet. Go to the #bGolem's Temple#k and hunt some #b#o9101054#s#k to get the #bDejected Green Mushroom Puppet#k.

yes.0: It seems like the #bGreen Mushroom Puppet#k's effect only applies to #o1110100#s. Thank goodness it had no effect on the #o9101054#s.

no.0: Please, just one more. This is really important.

1.0: You got the puppet! Excellent! Now I can work out exactly what's so weird about this thing.

yes.0: I'll give you a couple items as a thank you. Oh, don't worry, these are pretty easy to get. #m100000000# is a town of bowmen, after all. All right, I'm going to dive back into my work.

item.0: You haven't gotten the #b#t4034071##k yet? The #o9101054#s in the #bGolem's Temple#k should have them... Hah, that's a great image. A #o9101054# with a mushroom puppet? Wish I had a picture of that.
